_comment: Reason -> Intervention selection table AND the presentation spec, in one lookup so the UI renders conditionally instead of hardcoding five screens. tag_color maps to literal Tailwind classes in components/ui.tsx — Tailwind cannot scan JSON for class names, so they must live in a .tsx file.
